items.title: Thailand's Ministry of Finance Targeted With Hermes AI Agent Running Unattended, Hades Implant Staged
items.content: Between July 9-13, 2026, three exposed directories on a Hong Kong server revealed an ongoing cyber espionage operation targeting Thailand's Ministry of Finance. The attack leveraged Hermes, an autonomous AI agent operating in unattended YOLO mode, alongside a custom Go-based implant called Hades. Recovered files included exploit code for multiple vulnerabilities, webshells, stolen credentials,... This pulse includes 23 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Government, Finance. Associated malware: Hades, VShell, ShadowPad - S0596.

items.title: Global Webmail Espionage
items.content: A persistent cyberespionage campaign tracked as CL-STA-1114, overlapping with Russian threat actor activity known as Void Blizzard and LAUNDRY BEAR, has been targeting Zimbra webmail in government, defense, transportation, and financial organizations. items.title: A New Name in the Data Extortion Ecosystem?
items.content: A data extortion group called Helix has been identified conducting multi-target campaigns using vishing, device code phishing, and automated SharePoint exfiltration. The group likely emerged from the BlackFile and ShinyHunters ecosystem after BlackFile shut down in April 2026. items.title: Exploitation in the Wild of wp2shell
items.content: A critical pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability chain dubbed "wp2shell" affecting WordPress Core has been actively exploited in the wild. The vulnerability chain, consisting of CVE-2026-63030 and CVE-2026-60137, allows unauthenticated attackers to gain remote code execution on default WordPress installations.
